sources.title: Tagged interview note preserving generic shortest-path coding prompt

claims.text: The source preserves only a generic shortest-path coding prompt; graph direction, weight model, negative-edge policy, API and target are not preserved.
The candidate conditions BFS/Dijkstra/Bellman-Ford selection on the preserved-or-explicit weight contract instead of presenting Dijkstra as an unconditional source requirement.

Under the declared directed nonnegative-long contract with Long.MAX_VALUE reserved as unreachable/out-of-range sentinel, the exact Java implementation matches independent BigInteger Bellman-Ford results over fixed boundaries, 20,000 small random graphs and 5,000 near-long-maximum graphs and rejects negative edges.

validation.command: compile exact Java candidate and differential-test against independent BigInteger Bellman-Ford oracle
validation.reported_stdout: PASS fixed=covered zero-parallel-selfloop-unreachable=covered sentinel-boundary=covered random-small=20000 random-near-max=5000 negative-edge=rejected oracle=bellman-ford-bigint

boundary_tests.expected: exact distances match independent Bellman-Ford oracle

boundary_tests.case: Long.MAX_VALUE sentinel, Long.MAX_VALUE-1 finite value and overflow-path competition
boundary_tests.expected: reserved sentinel is never emitted as a representable finite path while Long.MAX_VALUE-1 remains representable
all distances equal independent Bellman-Ford oracle
all representable/sentinel results equal BigInteger Bellman-Ford oracle
declared Dijkstra reference contract rejects unsupported input

findings: The source preserves only the generic prompt “算法：最短路径”; direction, weight model, target, API and negative-edge semantics are not recoverable, and the candidate explicitly keeps those as clarification points before declaring its reference contract.

The candidate does not collapse shortest-path choices into one algorithm: it distinguishes BFS for equal-weight/unweighted graphs, Dijkstra for nonnegative weights and negative-edge algorithms such as Bellman-Ford when the weight model changes.

Within its declared directed nonnegative-long reference contract, the Java implementation maintains the Dijkstra relaxation invariant and handles stale priority-queue entries without an unsafe early visited fence.

The reserved Long.MAX_VALUE sentinel is now explicit: representable finite distances are strictly below the sentinel, Long.MAX_VALUE-1 is preserved, and sentinel-equal or overflowing candidates are not silently misrepresented as finite results.

Independent BigInteger Bellman-Ford differential testing passes fixed structural boundaries, 20,000 seeded small graphs and 5,000 seeded near-long-maximum graphs; negative edges are rejected as declared.
